blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: UPDATE — Changes values in existing rows.
WHERE — Restricts affected rows; omission can affect every row.

blocks.title: Change rows safely
blocks.text: UPDATE Table SET column=value WHERE key=...

blocks.title: Delete deliberately
blocks.text: DELETE FROM Table WHERE key=...; verify matches before writing.
